about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_spawn.py). bad replays the Unknown ChildProcess.kill failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real ChildProcess.kill line. good bounds the same case with a timeout, a slice, a file or a receipt: it writes scratch files and prints the bounded report it promises.
